period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) as at 2020-09-30. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2020 (as published in the FY2020 annual report's own 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table), NOT discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix; discrete-quarter figures were not computed by subtraction, per project convention (same as CITYBANK). Table title itself does not say 'Consolidated' or 'Solo' ('Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board'), but its own Dec-31-2020 column reproduces total_assets (269,269.26), gross_loans (203,887.32), total_deposits (190,120.48), total_liabilities (252,257.97) and total_equity (17,011.16) matching the already-confirmed-CONSOLIDATED 2020_Q4.json to within normal rounding, confirming this table is Consolidated basis too -- same basis as the rest of MTB's series, no mismatch. DISCREPANCY FOUND vs the already-stored 2020_Q4.json (sourced from mtb-annual-report-2023.txt (retrospective comparative)): gross_loans (table 203,887.32 vs stored 203,744, -0.07%); total_deposits (table 190,120.48 vs stored 188,734, -0.73%); operating_income (table 9,956.08 vs stored 9,987, +0.31%); tax_expense (table 858.53 vs stored 859, +0.05%). This session's source is mtb-annual-report-2020.txt's OWN contemporaneous 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table for FY2020 -- i.e. more contemporaneous than the currently-stored Q4 figure for the fields listed. Per this task's explicit scope limits, 2020_Q4.json is left UNMODIFIED; this divergence is recorded here and in sources.json for a future session to reconcile (see project standing rule preferring contemporaneous over later-restated figures -- the fields above are exactly the kind of case that rule is meant to catch). Other fields (total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, profit_after_tax) match closely (<0.08% drift, ordinary rounding). Balance-sheet identity (Total Property and Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest) validated exactly (max drift BDT 0.01m, pure decimal-rounding noise) for all four quarters of 2020, including this Q3. Non-Controlling Interest (~BDT 0.13-0.14m) is omitted as its own line item here (rounds to 0 in whole millions) but is included in the identity check above. Cumulative Total Operating Income, Net Profit After Tax and Interest Income all increase monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 for 2020 (Q1=2,750.20, Q2=5,012.55, Q3=7,247.47 for operating income; Q1=534.50, Q2=1,088.41, Q3=1,243.74 for net profit after tax) -- no violation. Separately, discrete Q4-alone net profit (970.39 annual cumulative minus 1,243.74 nine-month cumulative = a Q4-alone loss of ~BDT 273m) is visible by comparing this table's own Q3 and Q4 columns -- a real feature of MTB's COVID-19-year (FY2020) results (consistent with insights.json's 'covid_profitability_dip' signal), not an extraction error. This does not violate the Q1->Q2->Q3 monotonicity check above (which only covers the three quarters populated by this file) -- it is Q4 (already stored, not modified) that dips versus Q3.
